additional_concerns: For node.1bf6918f69c6b37738daeb83, node.4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e, node.ce439b1cf9ed8301fbb68f94 and node.ea4d19630f8cab09065b1909, preserved application processing becomes a substantive relief exclusion. Those boundaries do not resolve actual relief for legacy applications. Node.8eb374ffa546ddd2ba291e37 retains that unresolved question without executable meaning.

The specified commencement date supports a commencement condition, but the source does not fully identify the legally relevant assessment event. Its introductory immediate-effect language also requires reconciliation with the dated implementation provision. Node.4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e describes assessment for proposed implementation; its executable comparison tests assessment_date, not a separately established implementation date.

The relevant updated FAQs and authoritative transitional clarification are missing for resolving actual procedural relief and the legally relevant date. The supplied dependency IDs have null source hashes and no identifying descriptions, so neither can reliably be assigned to a particular missing authority. Applicable home-jurisdiction requirements would also be needed to establish home compliance for an actual change.

The introductory home-supervision purpose does not clearly impose an additional independent item (ii) condition. Item (ii) expressly uses home-requirements compliance; importing item (i)'s separate supervision condition would require further support.
